usage: 槓鈴 is a noun used to refer to a type of weight training equipment consisting of a long bar with weights at each end.
You can use 槓鈴 as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about gym exercises or fitness routines.
槓鈴 can be combined with verbs like 舉 (lift), 用 (use), or 買 (buy) to describe actions related to it.
In questions, 槓鈴 is often used with 問 (ask) or 幾錢 (how much) when inquiring about equipment or techniques.
槓鈴 is countable, so classifiers like 支 (zi1) or 個 (go3) can be used before it.
